metadata.name: Riot Junction
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A city intersection on a riot night. Rioters hold the north and west behind burning barricades of overturned cars; riot police push up from the south and east behind their barriers with an armoured APC. On the corners: the Quik Cash convenience store and its cash vault, the diner, the bar, the gas station (shoot the cylinders by the pumps) and the mechanic’s garage with cars up on lifts. Behind them: apartments with fire escapes up to rooftops joined by planks, alleys, a pawn shop and a laundromat, a parking garage with an open top deck, and a subway platform under the west avenue. Every shop window shoots out. Bomb sites: the vault (A) and the parking garage (B).
